metas.name: Live better for less
metas.description: Across seven European countries, seven hosts help households with big goals: decluttering, selling what they no longer need, and building habits that move them forward. From overflowing closets to forgotten sheds, the series reveals just how similar our problems are across Europe and offers tips and tricks for living better for less.

metas.name: Coração de Mãe
metas.description: “Coração de Mãe” is the story of Linda—an ordinary woman and a true warrior—who struggles to save her loved ones from a violent man. Faced with an inevitable transformation, she realizes there is no turning back: she must discover a way to change her life before it is too late.

metas.name: The Grand Tour
metas.description: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

metas.name: Jagamae Sangeetham
metas.description: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

metas.name: Dolore e Psiche
metas.description: *Dolore e Psiche* is a series that explores mental health through real-life locations, stories, and personal accounts. Ale meets patients, doctors, and healthcare professionals in specialized centers, hospital wards, secure psychiatric units (REMS), and rehabilitation communities, delving into various forms of mental distress and addiction. It is a journey—both human and educational—that moves beyond stigma, prejudice, and oversimplification.

metas.name: Les Fumiers: Welcome to the Farm
metas.description: Eight content creators leave their daily lives and comfort behind to take on a challenge set by four French farms: confronting the reality of agricultural life. Their mission: work hard, push their limits, and be the top performer to raise as much money as possible for their charity. Who will best adapt to this new life and win this unprecedented adventure?

metas.name: Meet the Owens
metas.description: Forget everything you think you know about Michael Owen. This is an action-packed and unexpectedly hilarious year in the life of the footballer-turned-Horse-Racing-Stable-owner & his famous family. Michael juggles a business on the edge with a chaotic home life, while daughter Gemma swaps social media for the saddle to become a jockey. Funny, warm… and far from boring.

metas.name: Oracles & Prophets
metas.description: historic figures or sacred sites believed to share messages from a deity or see the future. An oracle is often a shrine or the priestess who speaks riddles from a god (like the Oracle at Delphi), while a prophet is a person who delivers a direct divine message or call for moral change.

metas.name: A Beautiful Obsession
metas.description: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

metas.name: An Amputation Obsession: The Monster and the Surgeon
metas.description: Vascular surgeon Neil Hopper becomes a symbol of hope after losing both legs, until an investigation uncovers a hidden obsession and secret life.

metas.name: Castle Walls
metas.description: In the eleventh century, Hasan Sabbah captures the castle of Alamut and founds a mysterious movement that challenges the established order. While his old friend Nizam al-Mulk strives to protect the empire, Azazil—a warrior freed from the dungeon—emerges as his most loyal *fedai*. In this tale where friendship turns to enmity, love, faith, betrayal, and the lust for power fuel a conflict that alters the course of history.

metas.name: The Chosen in the Wild with Bear Grylls
metas.description: Follows Grylls as he takes the cast of The Chosen, as well as series creator Dallas Jenkins, on adventures in the wilderness.

metas.name: Gladiators - Die Show der Giganten
metas.description: "Gladiators – The Show of Giants," hosted by Laura Wontorra and Jan Köppen with commentary by Frank Buschmann, is a spectacular test of strength in which 17 gladiators face off against formidable professionals in action-packed games! Who will be crowned the Gladiators champion?

metas.name: Sterling Point
metas.description: After discovering she's inherited a remote island in Canada from the estranged grandfather she was never allowed to meet, 17-year-old Annie Jacobson decides to investigate, pulling her into a world of buried secrets, unexpected sisterhood, and the complicated family history she was never meant to find.

metas.name: BEAUTY BATTLE ROYALE: Japan-Korea Next-Generation Makeup Artist Championship
Bayrak Taşıyanlar
metas.description: The success stories of 4 Turkish national athletes who have etched their names in the minds of the world.

metas.name: Warota!
metas.description:
It is a sketch comedy series starring SixTONES, marking the group’s first attempt at comedy as a unit. The show features a range of formats, including situational sketches, short skits, and serialized comedy segments, all performed on full-scale, professionally designed sets.

In each episode, SixTONES collaborate with guest actors and emerging creators, taking on various scripts and creative directions. Through these performances, the members showcase their distinct personalities as they engage in dynamic and often chaotic comedic interactions. The series offers a unique side of SixTONES that is exclusive to this program.

metas.name: Fatal First Dates
metas.description: Fatal First Dates explores real cases where online dating and first meetings end in tragedy, revealing how trust, deception and modern technology can turn romance into danger.

metas.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
metas.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

metas.name: Cyborg 009 Nemesis
metas.description: Since their inception, the cyborg soldiers have protected humanity from various enemies threatening peace for over half a century. Yet the battle continues—a group of nine cyborgs called "Nemesis" convinced that 009 and his comrades alone cannot bring peace to the world has emerged. Led by Graviton, the cyborg who manipulates gravity, what is their ultimate goal? Will we witness a generational change!?

metas.name: Super Market
metas.description: Super Market is the new Italian Prime Original comedy series written and directed by the Il Terzo Segreto di Satira collective, following the tragicomic events of Eury, a chaotic neighborhood supermarket facing closure

metas.name: Undercover Lover
metas.description: 14 seemingly single men and women arrive at a stunning villa, but 5 are secretly in relationships. From a second villa, their partners watch as they try to keep their romance hidden. When sparks fly from the start, jealousy and distrust quickly create tension

metas.name: Young Farts Trailer Parts
metas.description: Small-town brothers Jagger and Dawson run Young Farts RV Parts, a multi-million-dollar business where they turn trailer trash into cash. Between outrageous schemes, chaotic stunts, and big-hearted hijinks, these brothers chase one wild idea after the next - all for the love of their family and the empire they’re building.

metas.name: The Criminal
metas.description: A random mass stabbing, major food company Titus Foods, and a mysterious infant disease. These three things have as much in common as Detective Soma, hack writer Yarimizu, and the stabbing's lone survivor, Shuji. Yet, these men are now embroiled in a risky quest for the truth. What they find, though, is more heinous than they imagined, making them question just who is the real criminal?

metas.name: Qesma w Naseeb: Al-Aroos w Al-Hamat
POTENTIAL "Tadayoshi Ohkura"
metas.description: Super Eight's Tadayoshi Ohkura has spent 22 years on stage. Now he channels that experience into mentoring 150+ trainees in this intimate documentary.

metas.name: Ride or Die
metas.description: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

metas.name: Murder 101
metas.description: Part teen drama, part masterclass, and part edge-of-your-seat crime investigation, follow a high school sociology class in rural Tennessee who help revive a decades-old case into a present-day hunt for a killer.

metas.name: La feria
metas.description: In the days leading up to the start of the April Fair, Marina, Natalia, Manu, and Carlos prepare to experience the most important week of the year. As they finalize preparations for the *Pescaíto* and juggle their commitments as content creators, both excitement and insecurities surface.

metas.name: The Loyalty Game
metas.description: A group of women runs a unique business: luring men to expose their infidelity. Their newest client, Ana, lives a seemingly perfect life with her devoted husband-until doubt creeps in. As he starts to distort her reality, Ana teams up with a loyalty tester, and their search for truth spirals into a dangerous game of secrets, manipulation, and power-where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

metas.name: Isakapatnam
metas.description: Set in the 1990s, in the ruthless port town of Isakapatnam, three forces collide—a woman driven by justice, a henchman torn by loyalty, and a common man hungry for revenge—each closing in on the empire built by the port’s most powerful man, Naidu.

metas.name: Elle
metas.description: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

metas.name: Kraken: The Black Book of Hours
metas.description: A crime series based on the bestseller *The Black Book of Hours* by Eva García Sáenz de Urturi. Kraken receives a mysterious phone call ordering him to track down a rare, valuable book; if he fails, his mother will be killed. The problem, however, is that his mother has been dead for decades. Together with his inseparable partner Esti, he must solve a complex case filled with suspense, action, and emotion.

metas.name: Alliance
metas.description: A competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points-the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

metas.name: What Would You Rather?: Decide to Survive
metas.description: Romesh Ranganathan hosts ten UK online stars playing Would You Rather for real. Fiendish dilemmas decide everything, from hilarious supersized games to how they eat and sleep. There's no right decision, but making the least worst choice could guarantee survival (in the game, not literally). You've played it hypothetically, now they're playing it for real, and only one will be crowned champion.

metas.name: Would You Rather: Decide to Survive
metas.description: Would You Rather be invisible or be able to fly? Fight one giant duck or 1000 tiny ducks? Eat a man-sized bean or a bean-sized man? This comedy game show will see two teams of some of Britain's funniest digital personalities compete in hilarious real-life challenges based on classic hypothetical Would You Rather decisions. These three simple words decide everything from what they eat to who they send home.

metas.name: Ab Hoga Hisaab
metas.description: Recently-deported NRI Bobby's life shatters when brother Bunty vanishes. His search exposes a human-trafficking ring masked as a Canada immigration network. With Inspector Dosanjh's help, Bobby battles corruption to save his brother.

metas.name: Sidemen Presents: Side-Menu
metas.description: The Sidemen are joined by a guest contestant as they take on a series of culinary challenges – a starter, main and dessert – with teams rotating every episode and individual points on the line.

metas.name: Chloe et Emma
metas.description: Having lost love, her job, and her home, Emma had hit rock bottom when she stumbled upon the estate of Chloe, a mysterious heiress. Unexpected happenings lead the two of them to become housemates, and together, they open a fortune-telling shop where troubled souls come searching for answers. The pair soon realize that each client's problem comes with hidden secrets and mysteries.

metas.name: Raakh
metas.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

metas.name: Every Year After
metas.description: Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

metas.name: The Ultimate Rider
metas.description: The Ultimate Rider is a high-performance reality series built to find the next professional motocross athlete. Sixteen riders. Two weeks. No outside contact. No second chances. Through relentless training, competition, and pressure, riders are pushed to their limits—physically, mentally, and emotionally. There are no eliminations. Only performance. Only progression. At the end, one rider earns a contract—and a future in professional motocross.

metas.name: Ticket to the Tribes
metas.description: In the new reality show, 12 Dutch and Flemish celebrities live together with the Himba community in Namibia. This means that the participants must live without modern amenities and adapt to the tribe's way of life. The participants are judged on their commitment and respect for the culture. The celebrities who adapt the least are eliminated. Ultimately, one participant remains. This person is appointed an honorary member by the community.

metas.name: The Pyramid Scheme
metas.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

metas.name: Patrocínio
metas.description: In a world dominated by filters and controlled narratives, "Patrocinio" breaks with the formality of one of Portugal's most influential families to offer an intimate and unprecedented access to the sisters' world. The camera ceases to be a guest at gala events and instead portrays the emotional, professional, and familial structure that sustains an empire of influence, work, and sisterhood.

metas.name: L'Affaire Céline Giboire - une contre-enquête de McSkyz
metas.description: On February 28, 2012, the body of 16-year-old Céline Giboire was found at the foot of a cliff in the Corbières park in Saint-Malo. Since then, her family has rejected the suicide theory put forward by the authorities and has fought to uncover the truth about the circumstances of her death. McSkyz revisits the case in an attempt to understand what happened to Céline.

metas.name: The 50
metas.description: Tension and strategy, clashes and provocations, but also fun, relationships and friendships, are the ingredients of The 50, the new reality game in which 50 of the most popular Italian celebrities and influencers will compete in a series of tests.

metas.name: Beating the Odds
metas.description: BEATing The Odds: BEAT is charting a new course. After a winless streak, the team has decided to make a change. With a new structure and renewed ambition, the quest for improvement begins. But in a sport where every detail matters, the question is: is this enough to truly break through?
